remedy.notes: Sanctions Order, Doc. 123, by Senior U.S. District Judge Sharion Aycock. The $8,000 is an aggregate of four separate per-attorney fines, not a single award. Bad faith was found only as to the two lead attorneys; the resident attorneys were found negligent and careless but not in bad faith. Do not attribute the defence tool to “First Drafts” — the order treats them as two distinct tools and names no vendor for either. Related but distinct corpus record: AIEL-2026-031 (In re Wise, Bankr. W.D. La.) involves the same plaintiff-side attorney; this order discusses that matter as later repeat conduct, and the Withers conduct predates it.
